# City Layers

> City Layers is a map-based community engagement platform that helps organisations involve communities in urban design, planning, and decisions about places. We help municipalities, transport operators, urban planners, NGOs and research institutions collect, map and act on community knowledge about how places work for people.

## Company
- Vienna, Austria. Grew out of participatory planning research at TU Wien.
- Reached more than 10,000 people through mapping campaigns and platform deployments.

## Products
- Campaign: expert-led community mapping projects, run by the City Layers team for municipalities, planners and organisations.
- Platform: a map-based engagement tool clients can run themselves to collect and analyse community input.
